diagnosis: The MongoDB billing query searches for invoice documents solely using the invoiceCode criteria without scoping the query to the authenticated caller's tenantId. In a shared multi-tenant MongoDB collection, any customer can retrieve sensitive enterprise invoices, including corporate tax numbers, IBAN remittance instructions, and itemized billing line items of other client corporations.
